$doc: §23.6 ST-2. Windows computed offline from UnitDetection.StepChance (PMax 0.9, EyeR50 400 m / OpticsR50 1200 m, Signature sqrt(men/9), a target standing still): steps = ceil(1/P(r)). R-8331: the naked eye is capped at the soldiers' TKB VisionRange (agg-backend R-8006, CE-8009) - 150 m for these men - so the mid range is read through an authored Optics holding (not capped); the pool row reads SquadCognitiveState, which the spawn fill now provisions (CE-8021) - the observers author none.

expect.name: a contact on the near target (100 m, eye) appears inside N-1's window (2 steps +- 3 s)
... the near contact lands in the observer's own contact pool (N-2; no authored pool, CE-8021)
a contact on the mid target (2100 m, optics) appears inside N-1's window (8 steps +- 3 s)
... the mid contact lands in the observer's own contact pool (N-2; no authored pool, CE-8021)
no contact on the far target (2500 m, eye) - beyond the sensors' reach
